item.title: 3 more N2O canisters were found on Horn Link Way, 27th November
item.description:
Hi Team, I found 3 more canisters on Horn Link Way at its very beginning as shown on the map on Fix My Street report (see below is exact Google Pin for convenience). I decided to leave them there as they are hidden adjacent to Horn Link Way’s curb (one of them seem intact and have a cap on). The reason I didn’t take them and left near the Peartree Way council bin is because tomorrow is Saturday and a lot of kids will be running around so I decided to leave them there as they are sort of hidden when looking from the pedestrian path adjacent to it. Please can you attend at your earliest convenience. Many thanks, local resident, A https://maps.app.goo.gl/NMT3YXW4oTtEudSk7?g_st=ic

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Horn Link Way, Greenwich
Report on FixMyStreet
